description: This Java class serves as a wrapper around the MeetingRepository, providing methods to retrieve, save, and delete Meeting entities while handling not found exceptions. It simplifies repository interactions by encapsulating common checks and exception handling.

classes.name: MeetingRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to fetch, save, and delete Meeting entities with integrated not found exception handling.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a Meeting by ID, throwing a MeetingNotFoundException if the Meeting does not exist.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a Meeting entity to the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified Meeting entity from the database.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves a Meeting and immediately flushes changes to the database.
